screen_summary: This is step 3 of 5 on a benefits website. It asks you to upload proof of income. The file you picked was not accepted because it is too big.
screen_text: File exceeds the maximum size of 5 MB
Allowed file types: PDF, JPG, PNG. Maximum size: 5 MB.
error_text_quoted: File exceeds the maximum size of 5 MB
error_meaning: The photo you picked is 8.4 MB. This website only takes files up to 5 MB, so it did not upload.

steps.text: Make the photo smaller, or take a new photo that is not zoomed in. A PDF scan also works.
Tap Choose File and pick the smaller file.
Tap Upload and wait for the file name to show.
If it still does not work, tap Back and start this step again.

cautions: The Submit Application button sends your whole application. Tap it only when every step is done.
